verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a full Invoicing API with official libraries, endpoints such as create_preview, webhooks for workflow transitions, an API for virtual bank account numbers, plus an official MCP server and CLI, so most invoicing work is programmable. However, several capabilities are documented only as Dashboard actions (CSV export via the Export button, credit notes via the Dashboard, branding customization in settings), and nothing states UI/API parity. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 at all candidate paths. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, evidenced API equivalents for Dashboard-only flows (export, credit notes, branding settings), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration
